paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Epoch and Loss for both training and validation datasets. The x-axis is labeled “Epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2.25, with tick labels at intervals of 0.25. A blue solid line represents the "Train" dataset; it begins at approximately 1.8 at an Epoch of 0, decreases to approximately 0.5 at an Epoch of 20, and ends at approximately 0.45 at an Epoch of 30. A green solid line represents the "Validation" dataset; starting at approximately 2.15 at an Epoch of 0, it decreases to approximately 1.3 at an Epoch of 5, then fluctuates between approximately 1.3 and 1.8 until approximately an Epoch of 15, after which it decreases to approximately 1.15 at an Epoch of 30.
